synthesizedFacts.fact: Allodynia is a condition where non-painful stimuli cause pain, often linked to nerve disorders such as fibromyalgia and migraines.
Sensitive skin can be a manifestation of both cutaneous disorders like dermatitis and extracutaneous conditions such as stress or hormonal changes.
Sudden skin sensitivity can be triggered by environmental changes, stress, overuse of skincare products, or underlying medical conditions.
